Summary: So, not wanting to overstep or force anything on Stiles, but wanting the earsplitting crowd around them to shut the hell up already, Derek leans forward. Stiles’ eyes widen instead of close, but his cheek is warm when Derek’s lips meet his skin, and suddenly the crowd is booing. Derek tears himself away, brows furrowed, but Stiles is still clinging onto his arm. When Derek meets his gaze, Stiles is biting his lip, trying to tamp down the grin that’s spreading there, eyes bright and cheeks flushed, as the crowd continues hollering around them. “Gimme kiss,” Stiles is then saying to him in a terrible Russian accent, and suddenly his fingers clench around the front of Derek’s green t-shirt, and Derek is being pulled forward, and his lips are meeting Stiles’ at last.
